name: s0
description: The three MMLongBench-Doc samples used for the 5 Oct 2026 end-to-end pipeline test (parser -> index -> planner -> orchestrator -> verifier -> official scorer). One easy text lookup, one figure question whose gold answer is 'Not answerable', one image-only slide deck with a pie-chart value.
author: Muhammad Talal Majeed

samples.question: What is NARL stand for in this document?
samples.why_chosen: Born-digital text report (20 pages). Single-page pure-text evidence. Tests parser text extraction, index navigation and grounding on the easiest case.

samples.question: In Figure 1's demonstration, what are the color of the nodes that appear in all three clusters?
samples.why_chosen: Academic paper (23 pages). Requires inspecting Figure 1 as an image; the correct output is abstention (Not answerable). Tests the image tool and the verifier's abstention.

samples.question: Regarding the global iOS breakdown, what percentage of the pie chart was iOS 9?
samples.why_chosen: Slide deck with NO text layer (34 pages, image-only). Parser must OCR; index must locate the iOS breakdown slide; answer sits in a pie chart. Tests OCR, index and chart reading.
